featured_reviews.review_text: I Am An Artist is a well-organized art institution for all prospective artists. Whether or not art is a talent. She is so patient and makes the class sessions very interesting and receptive. Her experience in handling students makes you want to attend class every time. She also finds out what you want to focus on and tailors the curriculum to suit your preference as well as improving the student’s knowledge in must-know areas. Any lost class within the period of tuition is arranged by the institution so you don’t miss any class session. This is value for money and quality client service. Art was my talent and I am now pursuing it after age 30. Guess what! I am loving what I could do with the pencil currently. It is never too late for you out there. Grab the phone and call ‘I Am An Artist’, enroll on any art related course and get started. You will be surprised what you will become after a few sessions. Oh yes to those who are wondering, my class was entirely online, yet very very productive beyond imagination. My sincere compliments and appreciation to Teacher Lakshmi and then to ‘I Am An Artist’ for making me realize what I failed to realize earlier. Find attached, some of my art works during the course.

name: AAIFA - ATUL ART INSTITUTE OF FINE ART
description: Atul Fine Art was founded by Mr. Atul Chaudhari in Mulund on 26th January, 1985. Ever since, over 40,000 students from different age groups and walks of life have been a part of this artful journey. Today Atul Fine Art caters to both, students who aspire to be Professional Artists as well as those who wish to pursue it as a Hobby. Students are prepared for a range of art fields including Applied Art, Fine Art, Interior Designing, Fashion Designing, Architecture, Digital Painting etc. The institute also prepares them to appear for Intermediate and Elementary Government Grade Examinations. Students, both young and old, explore their creativity through different mediums be it oils, acrylics, watercolors, charcoal, pencil rendering, etc.

featured_reviews.review_text: Five stars sound insane but let me tell you my story first. A big switch and it was the time when I didn't believe in my skills that much, thinking I wasn't any better but all I did was trust the process, trust and go with the flow of Silica. Things felt impossible as time was less, work was more. I'm so grateful for the silica team and the head Kavita maam for providing me with the guidance I needed. Design and general aptitude lectures were scheduled for me that helped me understand my skills and prepare for the entrance exams. I joined back in Feb 2026 and all had were two months until my private entrance exams in April 2026. Things were going too fast but still I managed to get into all the exams I appeared for all because of Silica Mulund. I know it sounds impossible but it's true. I could achieve something students put two years into all because I had Silica. The five stars represent their,amazing faculty, smart management of portion and schedule,interactive and creative lectures encouraging teachers and just a good time. I am deeply attached to Silica. It's like that one family member who is supportive and encouraging, providing you with the growth and guidance a person requires during their time of growth. I'm forever grateful. Thank you Silica mulund. ❤❤❤

featured_reviews.name: Mohit Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for the best design institute in Mulund, **Silica Institute** is hands down the place to be! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

From the moment you walk in, you can feel the positive and creative atmosphere. The faculty is incredibly knowledgeable, supportive, and genuinely invested in every student’s growth. They don’t just teach—they mentor, guide, and push you to bring out your absolute best.

What truly sets Silica apart is their structured curriculum and personalized attention. Whether it's preparation for design entrance exams like NID, NIFT, UCEED, or NATA, they provide clear concepts, regular practice sessions, mock tests, and detailed feedback that actually helps you improve.

The study material is well-designed and up-to-date, and the classroom environment encourages creativity and open thinking. The mentors are always approachable and ready to clear doubts, no matter how small.

I’ve seen tremendous improvement in confidence, sketching skills, and overall design thinking after joining Silica. If you're serious about building a career in design, Silica in Mulund is definitely the right choice. Highly recommended! ✨
